blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo. When your computer has a problem, the IT team helps you. In this lesson, "The Keyboard and Mouse", you learn the everyday English you need at work.

You use this English when you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting. It is simple English, but it is very useful. Today you learn five words. You practise them in short, natural sentences.

Go slow — one step at a time. Small IT habits today save big problems tomorrow. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can do it!

items.q: What does IT support at Czarnikow?
items.why: "IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo."

items.q: How many new words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn five words."

items.q: When do you use this English?
options: Only when you write emails at home
Only when you buy a new computer
When you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting
items.why: "You use this English when you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting."

items.q: The text says "Go slow — one step at a time." This suggests that…
options: the lesson is very long and hard
you do not need to learn everything fast
items.why: Inferência: "go slow, one step at a time" mostra que não é preciso ter pressa.

items.q: "Small IT habits today save big problems tomorrow" suggests that…
options: good habits now help you later
items.why: Inferência: hábitos pequenos e bons agora evitam problemas grandes no futuro.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James mostrar a mesa para o novo colaborador. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team! Let me show you your desk. It is a good desk, and it works well today.

Look here. There is a monitor on the desk. It is big and clear. There is a keyboard and a mouse too. And there is a black cable behind the monitor. The cable is fine, do not worry.

Now, there are two ports on the side of the computer. You put your USB in a port. There is one port here, and there is one port there. Easy, right?

On the monitor there is a small button. You press the button to turn it on. If the monitor is dark, press the button. That is all.

If something looks strange, call IT support. Sophie calls us all the time, and that is good. Our IT team is small, but we are very fast. Okay? You are ready. Have a great first day!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is on the desk?
options: A monitor, a keyboard and a mouse
items.why: "There is a monitor… There is a keyboard and a mouse too."

items.q: How many ports are on the side of the computer?
items.why: "there are two ports on the side of the computer."

items.q: What do you do with the button?
options: You put your USB in it
You press it to turn the monitor on
items.why: "You press the button to turn it on."

items.q: James says "do not worry" about the cable. This suggests that…
options: you must buy a new cable
the cable is okay and normal
items.why: Inferência: "the cable is fine, do not worry" mostra que está tudo bem com o cabo.

items.q: James says the IT team is "small, but we are very fast." This suggests that…
items.why: Inferência: pequeno mas rápido = eles ajudam depressa.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please put your papers on the desk." A desk is…
items.why: Desk = mesa de trabalho.

items.q: "The black cable is behind the computer." A cable is…
items.why: Cable = cabo, o fio que conecta as coisas.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I look at the ___ all day. The screen is big and clear."
items.why: Monitor = a tela que você olha; screen é a tela.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Press the green ___ to start the machine."
items.why: Button = botão, você aperta para iniciar.

items.q: "Put your USB in the port." A port is…
options: a small hole for a USB or cable
items.why: Port = porta (USB), a entrada onde você conecta o USB.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples de trabalho e do help desk. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please turn on the monitor." To turn on means to…
items.why: Turn on = ligar, fazer funcionar.

items.q: "Plug in the cable, please." To plug in means to…
options: put the cable in the socket
items.why: Plug in = plugar, conectar o cabo na tomada/entrada.

items.q: "I need to log in to my computer." To log in means to…
options: enter with your name and password
items.why: Log in = entrar no sistema com nome e senha.

items.q: "Can you help out with the printer?" To help out means to…
items.why: Help out = dar uma ajuda, ajudar em algo.

items.q: "Please back up your files today." To back up means to…
options: save a copy of your files
items.why: Back up = fazer backup, salvar uma cópia dos arquivos.
